transient_retry.eligibility: attempt incomplete without evaluator error; every native session complete, not started, or failed with a retained provider HTTP 5xx
transient_retry.what_counts: the final attempt of each cell must be complete and accounted; every earlier attempt is retained and published with its usage and latency
transient_retry.reporting: cells that needed a rerun, total reruns and first-attempt status counts are published beside the result

unchanged_from_sol100: completeness, nonempty aggregate evidence and actual complete assessor criteria
changed_from_sol100: recorded rerun of cells stopped only by upstream HTTP 5xx
specialists: not qualified by this schedule: original pilot paths do not activate built-in routing
semantic_quality: provisional; actual human adjudication remains outstanding
fallback: at most two further frozen schedules, each only after a diagnosed and fixed cause; every outcome retained; no post-hoc exclusion
